ip access-list extended NETOPS-IOS-ACCESS-CONTROL-V4
host02(config-ext-nacl)#
10 permit icmp any any
host02(config-ext-nacl)#
20 deny ip host 198.51.100.9 any
host02(config-ext-nacl)#
30 permit tcp 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255 any eq 22
host02(config-ext-nacl)#
40 permit tcp any any eq www
host02(config-ext-nacl)#
50 permit udp any host 198.51.100.1 eq snmp
host02(config-ext-nacl)#
100 permit ip any any
host02(config-ext-nacl)#
exit
host02(config)#
ip access-list extended NETOPS-IOS-ACCESS-CONTROL-EMPTY4
host02(config-ext-nacl)#
exit
host02(config)#
ipv6 access-list NETOPS-IOS-ACCESS-CONTROL-V6
host02(config-ipv6-acl)#
permit icmp any any sequence 10
host02(config-ipv6-acl)#
deny ipv6 host 2001:db8:1::9  any sequence 20
host02(config-ipv6-acl)#
sequence 25 deny tcp any any eq telnet
host02(config-ipv6-acl)#
sequence 30 permit tcp 2001:db8:1::0/64 any eq 22
host02(config-ipv6-acl)#
sequence 40 permit tcp any any eq www
host02(config-ipv6-acl)#
sequence 100 permit ipv6 any any
host02(config-ipv6-acl)#
exit
host02(config)#
ipv6 access-list NETOPS-IOS-ACCESS-CONTROL-EMPTY6
host02(config-ipv6-acl)#
exit
host02(config)#
ip access-list extended NETOPS-IOS-ACCESS-CONTROL-REMARK
host02(config-ext-nacl)#
remark ios-access-control remark test
host02(config-ext-nacl)#
permit ip any any
host02(config-ext-nacl)#
exit
host02(config)#
ip access-list extended NETOPS-IOS-ACCESS-CONTROL-OPTS
host02(config-ext-nacl)#
permit tcp any any range 80 90
host02(config-ext-nacl)#
permit ip any any log
host02(config-ext-nacl)#
exit
host02(config)#
